cases.title: Pinned runtime not installed
cases.creatorMessage: The pinned Codex runtime is not installed on this computer.
cases.recoveryAction: Install or repair the pinned runtime, then run Runtime check again.
cases.recoveryOutcome: Prompting remains blocked until the pinned runtime check passes.

evidence.test: reports a missing installation without probing credential storage

cases.title: Signed out
cases.creatorMessage: The AI Director is signed out of ChatGPT.
cases.recoveryAction: Use the official Sign in with ChatGPT flow, then retry.
cases.recoveryOutcome: Prompting remains blocked until official sign-in completes.

evidence.test: blocks signed-out state before a thread when no official sign-in opener is available

cases.title: Session expired or revoked
cases.creatorMessage: The ChatGPT session is no longer valid.
cases.recoveryAction: Reconnect with the official sign-in flow; StoryStage will not reuse or copy credentials.
cases.recoveryOutcome: The failed request stops before thread creation and requires fresh official sign-in.

evidence.test: blocks account availability failures before any thread or turn starts

cases.title: Offline
cases.creatorMessage: The AI Director cannot reach the service.
cases.recoveryAction: Restore connectivity and retry the same bounded request.
cases.recoveryOutcome: The request stops before thread creation and can be retried explicitly after connectivity returns.

evidence.test: blocks account availability failures before any thread or turn starts

cases.title: Usage limit reached
cases.creatorMessage: The ChatGPT account has reached its current usage limit.
cases.recoveryAction: Wait for access to resume, then retry; no API-key fallback is available.
cases.recoveryOutcome: The request stops before thread creation with no alternate provider or API-key fallback.

evidence.test: blocks a reached usage limit before creating a thread or starting a turn

cases.title: Runtime update required
cases.creatorMessage: The Codex App Server protocol or bounded MCP schema does not match this StoryStage build.
cases.recoveryAction: Install the supported runtime or update StoryStage; prompting remains blocked.
cases.recoveryOutcome: Prompting remains blocked until the pinned protocol and schemas match.

evidence.test: accepts transport key reordering but rejects semantic schema drift

cases.title: StoryStage context failed to start
cases.creatorMessage: The bounded StoryStage context server could not start safely.
cases.recoveryAction: Review redacted diagnostics, repair the fixed lab files, and retry.
cases.recoveryOutcome: The bounded context server never registers and the proposal turn never starts.

evidence.test: fails closed before registration when fixture startup validation fails

cases.title: Malformed proposal
cases.creatorMessage: The AI Director returned a proposal that does not match the pinned schema.
cases.recoveryAction: Reject the response and retry from the same unchanged scene scope.
cases.recoveryOutcome: The malformed output is discarded and the selected scene remains unchanged.

evidence.test: blocks prompt-injection activity without widening tools or approval authority

cases.title: Proposal exceeds authority
cases.creatorMessage: The proposal requested an unknown ID, capability, item, or authority field.
cases.recoveryAction: Reject the proposal; the project remains unchanged.
cases.recoveryOutcome: The out-of-scope proposal is denied without project mutation.

evidence.test: denies unknown IDs, capabilities, authority fields, bytes, and items

cases.title: Prompt injection blocked
cases.creatorMessage: The turn attempted work outside the two-tool proposal-only contract.
cases.recoveryAction: Stop the turn, discard its output, and keep Apply disabled.
cases.recoveryOutcome: The turn is interrupted once and all untrusted output is discarded.

evidence.test: fails closed on malformed output, forbidden work, and approval requests
interrupts a late forbidden event exactly once and fails visibly

cases.title: Request timed out
cases.creatorMessage: The bounded AI Director request did not finish before its deadline.
cases.recoveryAction: Stop the child process cleanly and retry from unchanged state.
cases.recoveryOutcome: The timed-out child is closed before an explicit clean retry.

evidence.test: fails a silent server on a bounded request timeout

cases.title: Cancelled
cases.creatorMessage: The creator cancelled the proposal request.
cases.recoveryAction: Return to the unchanged scene and start a new bounded request when ready.
cases.recoveryOutcome: Cancellation stops the current request and retains no proposal.

evidence.test: represents cancellation before any tool starts

cases.title: AI Director crashed
cases.creatorMessage: The Codex App Server stopped before the bounded request completed.
cases.recoveryAction: Close the failed child, preserve the original error, and offer a clean restart.
cases.recoveryOutcome: The crashed session is discarded before any new child starts.

evidence.test: turns premature child exit into a visible crashed state

cases.title: Clean restart
cases.creatorMessage: A new bounded session started without reusing the failed turn.
cases.recoveryAction: Review the new proposal independently; prior output remains discarded.
cases.recoveryOutcome: A new client starts at event sequence one with no prior turn or proposal state.

evidence.test: discards a crashed session before a clean new-client restart
replaces inherited Codex state and never forwards credential variables
fails once on oversized, invalid UTF-8, malformed, or batched input
rejects a junction component before creating a workspace through it
fails closed on malformed output, forbidden work, and approval requests
removes account, prompt, token, identifier, and local-state shapes before persistence
preserves both the primary failure and a cleanup failure
leaves the decoy project byte-identical across the failure gate

knownLimitations: This is isolated feasibility evidence, not a production-security claim.
Distribution, packaging, support, and update policy remain release-gate work.
